quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.
quests.hint: 'fan' and 'van' use the same lip and teeth position - only the voicing changes.
quests.explanation: The speaker said "van." The /v/ is voiced - you should feel your lips and teeth buzzing. "Fan" would use the voiceless /f/, with airflow but no buzz.
quests.vowelTensionRule: /f/ and /v/ are both made by touching the top teeth to the bottom lip. /f/ pushes air with no voice; /v/ adds a buzzing voice.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.

quests.explanation: The speaker said "fast." The /f/ is voiceless - just air passing between your teeth and lip. "Vast" would add a vocal buzz to that same airflow.
quests.vowelTensionRule: Watch the teeth-on-lip contact — it's the same for both sounds. The only change is voicing: /f/ is a quiet hiss, /v/ is a buzz.
